documentation.cara_kerja: Fetch real-time crypto prices dari CoinGecko/Binance API, hitung portfolio value berdasarkan holdings, kalkulasi P&L (realized + unrealized), dan generate performance metrics (ROI, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown).
documentation.fungsi: Dashboard komprehensif untuk crypto portfolio: current value, total P&L, per-asset performance, dan risk metrics. Support multi-wallet aggregation.
documentation.tujuan: Real-time visibility ke crypto portfolio performance untuk informed decision-making tanpa manual tracking.

wallet_addresses.description: List of wallet addresses to track
